title: Container Water Basic
constraints: The two selected lines remain vertical at their original indices.

examples.explanation: Width 1 multiplied by limiting height 1 gives area 1.
The two height-4 boundary lines have width 4.

solutionApproaches.title: Check Every Pair of Lines
solutionApproaches.explanation: Calculate the area for every pair; correct but too slow for a large height array.

solutionApproaches.title: Two Pointers From Both Ends
solutionApproaches.explanation: Measure the outer pair, then move only the shorter boundary because the taller one limits no future improvement.
